label: Convergence of a real sequence: A sequence of real numbers t 0, t 1,... converges to L when for…
definition: A sequence of real numbers t 0, t 1, ... converges to L when for every neighbourhood of L all but finitely many terms lie in it; in Lean this is Mathlib's Filter.Tendsto t Filter.atTop (nhds L). Terms may approach L without ever equalling it.
note: The standard analytic notion, taken from Mathlib rather than hand-rolled (AGENTS.md invariant 14). It is distinct from DEF-SUPERTASK-STABLE-LIMIT, which requires a Boolean output to become constant; these predicates have different carriers and are not directly strength-ordered; see DISAMB-SUPERTASK-LIMIT-NOTION. Mathematical convergence of stage times says nothing about whether a physical process reaches the limit. Declaration completion: RealSequenceConvergesTo quantifies over every real sequence and limit with the ordinary epsilon/eventual distance body; realSequenceConvergesTo_iff_tendsto proves exact equivalence to Mathlib. ConvergentZenoSchedule.analyticLimit consumes the original schedule certificate unchanged. No physical completion bridge is discharged.
